name: Villanueva de Argaño (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a blue wavy stripe near the top and another near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Argaño (a wavy fess on blue, stars and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Argaño; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de Argaño arms — wavy fess, stars and tree
